alternative_explanations: Revenue attribution to specific military expenditures is not established by this record.

alternative_explanations: Exact flows vary by site and actor; sector-level findings must not be assigned to every unit or operation.

resource_description: Global Witness reported access fees, taxation and jade-related revenue as important to KIO/A finances, with jade described as its largest single income source.
alternative_explanations: This is actor-specific and must not be generalized to all ethnic armed organizations or anti-coup resistance groups.

alternative_explanations: Historical jade financing does not by itself establish financing of the post-coup anti-junta campaign.
